# Icon audit — generated by `node tools/build-icon-manifest.mjs`

Filename and registry audit only — nothing here was judged by looking at the
art. 121 distinct supplied files: **83 live** (committed, now the default),
**12 owed** (has a place, file not in git), **20 with no place**,
**3 duplicates**, 3 already used as backup art. The lists below also
show committed dotted files the tree picked up from public/icons.
